notes: The location we track (3232 McKinney Ave, Dallas) does not appear on the site: it is not in the list of locations or in the location choices on the happy hour page. The /dallas URL actually shows the Plano, TX location (7200 Bishop Road), which has a happy hour Sun-Fri 3-6pm and Sat 2-5pm at the bar, with $10 bites, cocktails, wine and spirits and $5 beer. The site only says the happy hour is offered 'at select locations', so I left it out rather than assign Plano's deal to the McKinney Ave address. The McKinney Ave location may be closed.
